product_metadata.title: Betty Crocker BC-2405C 3-Cup Chopper
features: Press and Chop: When it comes to truly effective kitchen appliances, our BETTY CROCKER food chopper (7.87” x 6.89” x 5.04”) is the best. Simply press a button for pulse control and 2-speed settings.
3 Cup Capacity: Chop, mince, dice, and puree with our incredible food chopper electric. This 3 cup mini chopper (2.18 lbs.) ensures plenty of room for food preparation for parties and other events.
Stainless Steel Blades: This is considered one of the top kitchen accessories because it functions as an onion chopper, herb grinder, and much more. Enjoy heavy-duty stainless steel blades.
Hassle-Free Cleanup: Our veggie chopper is simple to use and doesn't require extensive cleanup. The bowl on this outstanding chopper electric is dishwasher safe, as are the lid and blades.
Easy to Store: This BETTY CROCKER compact electric food chopper easily fits into kitchen cabinets, storage containers, large drawers, pantries, and anywhere else convenient in your kitchen.
